messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: metrics.pipeline.scrape_signal_loss (severity: P1). Affected: prod-prom-cluster-1 — >90% targets missing for the last 3m. Pager: @pagerduty. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/repo/monitoring/scrape-signal-loss :rotating_light:
Nick (oncall): acked. I'm on it — looking at prom targets and grafana panels now.
Sage: also seeing 5xx from several exporters in eu region, repeating errors: "connection reset by peer" and intermittent timeouts.
Nick (oncall): grafana: prometheus:scrape_success ratio dropped from 0.99 to 0.1 at 13:04 UTC across eu nodes. Trying quick curl to exporter on node12.
Lin: quick heads up — kubelet on k8s-node-12 shows oom-kill churn for exporter containers. suspect node-level memory pressure.
Lin: ```
kubectl get pods -n monitoring -o wide | grep exporter
monitoring-app-exporter-1   CrashLoopBackOff   0/3   8m   k8s-node-12
monitoring-app-exporter-2   Running            2/2   10m  k8s-node-13
```
Cassie: can we evac node12? If it's OOMing repeatedly it might keep flapping and keep scrapes missing.
Maria: flagging customer impact: dashboards that rely on prometheus scraped metrics will show gaps; not yet seeing downstream alerts firing but log-ingest backlog is creeping up (seen in ingestion.pipeline.backlog). I'm opening a ticket INC-12345 for tracking/notifications.
Nick (oncall): cordon/drain plan: cordon node12 -> evict monitoring/exporter pods -> let scheduler place on node13. Runbook step 2/3 applied. @pagerduty please escalate to infra if cordon fails or node has hardware faults.
deploy-bot: cordon k8s-node-12 initiated by Nick (oncall) (command: `kubectl cordon k8s-node-12`).
Nick (oncall): cordon succeeded. Starting drain (graceful) with 120s timeout.
Lin: eviction in progress, watcher shows exporter recreated on node13. Pod stable now.
Sage: scrape_success back to ~0.96 and counting; some scrapes still high latency but success ratio recovering. Pushing 10m watch window.
Maria: log-ingest backlog rate flattening, but still up ~25% over baseline. Customer notifications queued; will update INC-12345 with timeline and mitigation steps.
Nick (oncall): monitoring runbook step 4: verify alerting config unaffected and close PD when stable for 15m. I'll keep thread open and watch for 15m, then close/annotate PD. Thanks all for quick responses. :thumbsup:
Cassie: recommend follow-up postmortem: root cause appears node-level memory pressure; propose adding exporter liveness tuning + node memory alert to catch earlier.
Nick (oncall): acknowledged. Creating follow-up ticket PM-6789 for retro and config changes.
pagerduty: PagerDuty incident acknowledged by Nick (oncall). Incident will auto-resolve when alert clears or manually by oncall.
Sage: feel free to hand back to infra for deeper node investigation — I think immediate mitigations done.
Nick (oncall): handing off to infra for root cause — tagging Cassie and Lin. I'll resolve PD after 15m stable window. Closing updates in INC-12345.
